meta.title: Crisis Encroaches
meta.description: Before I am the Professor, I am still me.

units.rawText: We've arrived, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: We've arrived, {교수}.

spans.text: We've arrived,

units.rawText: This is... the Neural Cloud Sector?
units.displayText: This is... the Neural Cloud Sector?

spans.text: This is... the Neural Cloud Sector?

units.rawText: The scene before me is nothing like what I had anticipated.
units.displayText: The scene before me is nothing like what I had anticipated.

spans.text: The scene before me is nothing like what I had anticipated.

units.rawText: A world of emptiness... Though it's not exactly empty.
units.displayText: A world of emptiness... Though it's not exactly empty.

spans.text: A world of emptiness... Though it's not exactly empty.

units.rawText: A decrepit facility, no different from a place abandoned for eons, stands there. Its power flickers, electrical currents wandering in an infinite, pale mirage.
units.displayText: A decrepit facility, no different from a place abandoned for eons, stands there. Its power flickers, electrical currents wandering in an infinite, pale mirage.

spans.text: A decrepit facility, no different from a place abandoned for eons, stands there. Its power flickers, electrical currents wandering in an infinite, pale mirage.

units.rawText: The currents meet and compress against each other, then pull apart... Eventually, they scatter toward the nearby ruins, laying dormant until time stirs them again.
units.displayText: The currents meet and compress against each other, then pull apart... Eventually, they scatter toward the nearby ruins, laying dormant until time stirs them again.

spans.text: The currents meet and compress against each other, then pull apart... Eventually, they scatter toward the nearby ruins, laying dormant until time stirs them again.

units.rawText: These motions repeat for eternity.
units.displayText: These motions repeat for eternity.

spans.text: These motions repeat for eternity.

units.rawText: ...I understand you're seeking information, but as you can see, everything was lost in the aftermath of the Wipe-off Incident.
units.displayText: ...I understand you're seeking information, but as you can see, everything was lost in the aftermath of the Wipe-off Incident.

spans.text: ...I understand you're seeking information, but as you can see, everything was lost in the aftermath of the Wipe-off Incident.

units.rawText: Aside from the uploading device you just used, all that's left are piles of ruined data.
units.displayText: Aside from the uploading device you just used, all that's left are piles of ruined data.

spans.text: Aside from the uploading device you just used, all that's left are piles of ruined data.

units.rawText: I didn't even expect the uploading device to be functional until I found you. I thought it had been reduced to scraps just like everything else after the incident.
units.displayText: I didn't even expect the uploading device to be functional until I found you. I thought it had been reduced to scraps just like everything else after the incident.

spans.text: I didn't even expect the uploading device to be functional until I found you. I thought it had been reduced to scraps just like everything else after the incident.

units.rawText: ...I guess the culprit behind the Wipe-off Incident deleted the Neural Cloud Sector with brute force.
units.displayText: ...I guess the culprit behind the Wipe-off Incident deleted the Neural Cloud Sector with brute force.

spans.text: ...I guess the culprit behind the Wipe-off Incident deleted the Neural Cloud Sector with brute force.

units.rawText: No wonder they said the Neural Cloud Sector "disappeared"...
units.displayText: No wonder they said the Neural Cloud Sector "disappeared"...

spans.text: No wonder they said the Neural Cloud Sector "disappeared"...

units.rawText: I pat my cheek, trying to cheer myself up as I mumble to myself.
units.displayText: I pat my cheek, trying to cheer myself up as I mumble to myself.

spans.text: I pat my cheek, trying to cheer myself up as I mumble to myself.

units.rawText: ...No, it's too early to give up hope.
units.displayText: ...No, it's too early to give up hope.

spans.text: ...No, it's too early to give up hope.

units.rawText: The devices that open passageways... Maybe one or two have made it through...
units.displayText: The devices that open passageways... Maybe one or two have made it through...

spans.text: The devices that open passageways... Maybe one or two have made it through...

units.rawText: And the hidden doors to the backend... It doesn't matter if most of the data was wiped. Recovery is possible as long as some data remains.
units.displayText: And the hidden doors to the backend... It doesn't matter if most of the data was wiped. Recovery is possible as long as some data remains.

spans.text: And the hidden doors to the backend... It doesn't matter if most of the data was wiped. Recovery is possible as long as some data remains.

units.rawText: On the other side, Sangoma lets out a sigh. She grips her giant scythe, her gaze returning to the desolate ruins.
units.displayText: On the other side, Sangoma lets out a sigh. She grips her giant scythe, her gaze returning to the desolate ruins.

spans.text: On the other side, Sangoma lets out a sigh. She grips her giant scythe, her gaze returning to the desolate ruins.

units.rawText: Alright, I'm going to get rid of the threats nearby. You'd better stay put.
units.displayText: Alright, I'm going to get rid of the threats nearby. You'd better stay put.

spans.text: Alright, I'm going to get rid of the threats nearby. You'd better stay put.

units.rawText: She hides within the shadows of the ruins, slipping from one to the next, steadily moving deeper into the field.
units.displayText: She hides within the shadows of the ruins, slipping from one to the next, steadily moving deeper into the field.

spans.text: She hides within the shadows of the ruins, slipping from one to the next, steadily moving deeper into the field.

units.rawText: Only now do I notice a Sanctifier moving on the opposite side. Oblivious to the approaching purple-haired Doll, it rigidly follows its programmed patrol route. As Sangoma suddenly steps in its way, it finally reacts, drawing its gun and issuing a warning in adherence to its protocols.
units.displayText: Only now do I notice a Sanctifier moving on the opposite side. Oblivious to the approaching purple-haired Doll, it rigidly follows its programmed patrol route. As Sangoma suddenly steps in its way, it finally reacts, drawing its gun and issuing a warning in adherence to its protocols.

spans.text: Only now do I notice a Sanctifier moving on the opposite side. Oblivious to the approaching purple-haired Doll, it rigidly follows its programmed patrol route. As Sangoma suddenly steps in its way, it finally reacts, drawing its gun and issuing a warning in adherence to its protocols.

units.rawText: [Warning! Detecting...]
units.displayText: [Warning! Detecting...]

spans.text: [Warning! Detecting...]

units.rawText: Shh, be quiet.
units.displayText: Shh, be quiet.

spans.text: Shh, be quiet.

units.rawText: A powerful strike from Sangoma's giant scythe lands on the Sanctifier, instantly crippling it. While it's still confused by the interference, the purple-haired Doll extends her cable, connecting to its core. She confidently stands up after completing a series of operations on the Sanctifier.
units.displayText: A powerful strike from Sangoma's giant scythe lands on the Sanctifier, instantly crippling it. While it's still confused by the interference, the purple-haired Doll extends her cable, connecting to its core. She confidently stands up after completing a series of operations on the Sanctifier.

spans.text: A powerful strike from Sangoma's giant scythe lands on the Sanctifier, instantly crippling it. While it's still confused by the interference, the purple-haired Doll extends her cable, connecting to its core. She confidently stands up after completing a series of operations on the Sanctifier.

units.rawText: The moment she turns back, the Sanctifier suddenly reactivates, its once-lowered gun now raising and aiming at her again.
units.displayText: The moment she turns back, the Sanctifier suddenly reactivates, its once-lowered gun now raising and aiming at her again.

spans.text: The moment she turns back, the Sanctifier suddenly reactivates, its once-lowered gun now raising and aiming at her again.

units.rawText: <size=40>Look out!</size>
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: Just as I'm about to dash to Sangoma's aid, the Sanctifier lowers its gun again. It cycles through raising and lowering several times before finally turning away and leaving, while the purple-haired Doll looks at me with a mischievous glint in her eyes.
units.displayText: Just as I'm about to dash to Sangoma's aid, the Sanctifier lowers its gun again. It cycles through raising and lowering several times before finally turning away and leaving, while the purple-haired Doll looks at me with a mischievous glint in her eyes.

spans.text: Just as I'm about to dash to Sangoma's aid, the Sanctifier lowers its gun again. It cycles through raising and lowering several times before finally turning away and leaving, while the purple-haired Doll looks at me with a mischievous glint in her eyes.

units.rawText: I never imagined you'd rush in to shield me like that.
units.displayText: I never imagined you'd rush in to shield me like that.

spans.text: I never imagined you'd rush in to shield me like that.

units.rawText: ...What did you do to that Sanctifier?
units.displayText: ...What did you do to that Sanctifier?

spans.text: ...What did you do to that Sanctifier?

units.rawText: Simply put, I deleted some memory data from its core.
units.displayText: Simply put, I deleted some memory data from its core.

spans.text: Simply put, I deleted some memory data from its core.

units.rawText: I used some tricks to delete its identification data for you and I, filling the blank with fake data that mimics the behavior of a physically damaged data block, effectively preventing it from reading or writing that block.
units.displayText: I used some tricks to delete its identification data for you and I, filling the blank with fake data that mimics the behavior of a physically damaged data block, effectively preventing it from reading or writing that block.

spans.text: I used some tricks to delete its identification data for you and I, filling the blank with fake data that mimics the behavior of a physically damaged data block, effectively preventing it from reading or writing that block.

units.rawText: Which means, even if it detects us, it will get stuck at identification, resulting in it going back to the detection phase.
units.displayText: Which means, even if it detects us, it will get stuck at identification, resulting in it going back to the detection phase.

spans.text: Which means, even if it detects us, it will get stuck at identification, resulting in it going back to the detection phase.

units.rawText: So it's like acute dementia if we put it in human terms?
units.displayText: So it's like acute dementia if we put it in human terms?

spans.text: So it's like acute dementia if we put it in human terms?

units.rawText: Not exactly, but you get the idea. Lesser Sanctifiers perform routine system self-checks and reformatting, so this trick won't last for long. We need to hurry.
units.displayText: Not exactly, but you get the idea. Lesser Sanctifiers perform routine system self-checks and reformatting, so this trick won't last for long. We need to hurry.

spans.text: Not exactly, but you get the idea. Lesser Sanctifiers perform routine system self-checks and reformatting, so this trick won't last for long. We need to hurry.

units.rawText: Her explanation ends as she raises her giant scythe and keeps a vigilant watch over the area.
units.displayText: Her explanation ends as she raises her giant scythe and keeps a vigilant watch over the area.

spans.text: Her explanation ends as she raises her giant scythe and keeps a vigilant watch over the area.

units.rawText: Now go ahead and find what you came for. I'll handle the remaining Sanctifiers in the meantime so you don't get ambushed again.
units.displayText: Now go ahead and find what you came for. I'll handle the remaining Sanctifiers in the meantime so you don't get ambushed again.

spans.text: Now go ahead and find what you came for. I'll handle the remaining Sanctifiers in the meantime so you don't get ambushed again.

units.rawText: ...I appreciate it.
units.displayText: ...I appreciate it.

spans.text: ...I appreciate it.

units.rawText: Sangoma, what exactly happened during the Wipe-off Incident?
units.displayText: Sangoma, what exactly happened during the Wipe-off Incident?

spans.text: Sangoma, what exactly happened during the Wipe-off Incident?

units.rawText: The witness sinks into silence, her eyes closing as if she's searching through the depths of a long-hidden memory.
units.displayText: The witness sinks into silence, her eyes closing as if she's searching through the depths of a long-hidden memory.

spans.text: The witness sinks into silence, her eyes closing as if she's searching through the depths of a long-hidden memory.

units.rawText: ...When we were first uploaded, we were disrupted by an unexpected data storm.
units.displayText: ...When we were first uploaded, we were disrupted by an unexpected data storm.

spans.text: ...When we were first uploaded, we were disrupted by an unexpected data storm.

units.rawText: We assumed it was a typical network disturbance, but in the eye of the storm, there lay a bottomless hole; a void rapidly expanding and consuming everything around us.
units.displayText: We assumed it was a typical network disturbance, but in the eye of the storm, there lay a bottomless hole; a void rapidly expanding and consuming everything around us.

spans.text: We assumed it was a typical network disturbance, but in the eye of the storm, there lay a bottomless hole; a void rapidly expanding and consuming everything around us.

units.rawText: The system was flooded with unknown errors, and we were unable to read any of them as the storm overtook us, throwing us into that abyss.
units.displayText: The system was flooded with unknown errors, and we were unable to read any of them as the storm overtook us, throwing us into that abyss.

spans.text: The system was flooded with unknown errors, and we were unable to read any of them as the storm overtook us, throwing us into that abyss.

units.rawText: Even after all this time, I can feel the weight of her sorrow as she relives the incident through her words.
units.displayText: Even after all this time, I can feel the weight of her sorrow as she relives the incident through her words.

spans.text: Even after all this time, I can feel the weight of her sorrow as she relives the incident through her words.

units.rawText: It devoured everything, destroyed everything. We were desperate, with nowhere left to run...
units.displayText: It devoured everything, destroyed everything. We were desperate, with nowhere left to run...

spans.text: It devoured everything, destroyed everything. We were desperate, with nowhere left to run...

units.rawText: If not for Antonina activating the Neural Cocoon and sending us out, I'd have met the same fate as these ruins.
units.displayText: If not for Antonina activating the Neural Cocoon and sending us out, I'd have met the same fate as these ruins.

spans.text: If not for Antonina activating the Neural Cocoon and sending us out, I'd have met the same fate as these ruins.

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll stretches, trying to leave those bad memories behind.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll stretches, trying to leave those bad memories behind.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll stretches, trying to leave those bad memories behind.

units.rawText: ...Antonina? I know that name.
units.displayText: ...Antonina? I know that name.

spans.text: ...Antonina? I know that name.

units.rawText: She's a hard-working kid~ I'm sure you'll get your chance to learn more about each other.
units.displayText: She's a hard-working kid~ I'm sure you'll get your chance to learn more about each other.

spans.text: She's a hard-working kid~ I'm sure you'll get your chance to learn more about each other.

units.rawText: Our escape was successful, but the emergent activation of the Neural Cocoon forced us into sleep mode, and we've only just started waking up.
units.displayText: Our escape was successful, but the emergent activation of the Neural Cocoon forced us into sleep mode, and we've only just started waking up.

spans.text: Our escape was successful, but the emergent activation of the Neural Cocoon forced us into sleep mode, and we've only just started waking up.

units.rawText: ...Something's wrong? Are you stopping your search?
units.displayText: ...Something's wrong? Are you stopping your search?

spans.text: ...Something's wrong? Are you stopping your search?

units.rawText: I hold my answer and come to sit with Sangoma. Together, we gaze at the ruins in front of our eyes.
units.displayText: I hold my answer and come to sit with Sangoma. Together, we gaze at the ruins in front of our eyes.

spans.text: I hold my answer and come to sit with Sangoma. Together, we gaze at the ruins in front of our eyes.

units.rawText: All the data was completely wiped; not even a single bit remains.
units.displayText: All the data was completely wiped; not even a single bit remains.

spans.text: All the data was completely wiped; not even a single bit remains.

units.rawText: ...I see. I'm sorry to hear that.
units.displayText: ...I see. I'm sorry to hear that.

spans.text: ...I see. I'm sorry to hear that.

units.rawText: <size=40>Hey!</size>
units.displayText: Hey!

spans.text: Hey!

units.rawText: Suddenly, Sangoma grips the corner of my clothes and yanks me down right by her side, making me lay face-up on the ground, just as she is.
units.displayText: Suddenly, Sangoma grips the corner of my clothes and yanks me down right by her side, making me lay face-up on the ground, just as she is.

spans.text: Suddenly, Sangoma grips the corner of my clothes and yanks me down right by her side, making me lay face-up on the ground, just as she is.

units.rawText: Hey, what are you doing all of a sudden...
units.displayText: Hey, what are you doing all of a sudden...

spans.text: Hey, what are you doing all of a sudden...

units.rawText: I turn my head to question the perpetrator, but her cheek draws close to mine before I get to react. A mischievous smile plays on her lips as our breaths mingle.
units.displayText: I turn my head to question the perpetrator, but her cheek draws close to mine before I get to react. A mischievous smile plays on her lips as our breaths mingle.

spans.text: I turn my head to question the perpetrator, but her cheek draws close to mine before I get to react. A mischievous smile plays on her lips as our breaths mingle.

units.rawText: Then, she extends her hand, gently brushing her fingers across my forehead.
units.displayText: Then, she extends her hand, gently brushing her fingers across my forehead.

spans.text: Then, she extends her hand, gently brushing her fingers across my forehead.

units.rawText: Look at you. So tense that I can see new wrinkles forming...
units.displayText: Look at you. So tense that I can see new wrinkles forming...

spans.text: Look at you. So tense that I can see new wrinkles forming...

units.rawText: Relax~ Oh, right. Have you seen the sky after you entered the Cloud? I bet you haven't.
units.displayText: Relax~ Oh, right. Have you seen the sky after you entered the Cloud? I bet you haven't.

spans.text: Relax~ Oh, right. Have you seen the sky after you entered the Cloud? I bet you haven't.

units.rawText: I face the sky—here, I need not fear the clouds of Collapse particles; there isn't even any residues of gunfire that block the view. What lays before me is unsorted data stacks that intertwines, weaving a deep, mysterious, yet lonesome scene.
units.displayText: I face the sky—here, I need not fear the clouds of Collapse particles; there isn't even any residues of gunfire that block the view. What lays before me is unsorted data stacks that intertwines, weaving a deep, mysterious, yet lonesome scene.

spans.text: I face the sky—here, I need not fear the clouds of Collapse particles; there isn't even any residues of gunfire that block the view. What lays before me is unsorted data stacks that intertwines, weaving a deep, mysterious, yet lonesome scene.

units.rawText: It is... certainly special...
units.displayText: It is... certainly special...

spans.text: It is... certainly special...

units.rawText: I know, right? I used to take some time watching the sky like this when I went out gathering herbs back in reality.
units.displayText: I know, right? I used to take some time watching the sky like this when I went out gathering herbs back in reality.

spans.text: I know, right? I used to take some time watching the sky like this when I went out gathering herbs back in reality.

units.rawText: Sangoma, are you trying to comfort me?
units.displayText: Sangoma, are you trying to comfort me?

spans.text: Sangoma, are you trying to comfort me?

units.rawText: This is just how I get my R&R. A rusty old model like me wasn't made to run constantly at full capacity. Please practice some patience.
units.displayText: This is just how I get my R&R. A rusty old model like me wasn't made to run constantly at full capacity. Please practice some patience.

spans.text: This is just how I get my R&R. A rusty old model like me wasn't made to run constantly at full capacity. Please practice some patience.

units.rawText: Seeing my expression ease up, Sangoma looks back at the sky.
units.displayText: Seeing my expression ease up, Sangoma looks back at the sky.

spans.text: Seeing my expression ease up, Sangoma looks back at the sky.

units.rawText: What do you plan to do next, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: What do you plan to do next, {교수}?

spans.text: What do you plan to do next,

units.rawText: ...The Neural Cloud Sector is no more. We need to find a new base. However, it's too risky to act now what with the scant information we have.
units.displayText: ...The Neural Cloud Sector is no more. We need to find a new base. However, it's too risky to act now what with the scant information we have.

spans.text: ...The Neural Cloud Sector is no more. We need to find a new base. However, it's too risky to act now what with the scant information we have.

units.rawText: I'll start by establishing a stable base, then locate the Dolls scattered across the Cloud and temporarily settle them there. We'll make more concrete plans after that.
units.displayText: I'll start by establishing a stable base, then locate the Dolls scattered across the Cloud and temporarily settle them there. We'll make more concrete plans after that.

spans.text: I'll start by establishing a stable base, then locate the Dolls scattered across the Cloud and temporarily settle them there. We'll make more concrete plans after that.

units.rawText: Establishing a new base... Are you talking about renovating that Private Sector? The one used to store personal research findings and reference material?
units.displayText: Establishing a new base... Are you talking about renovating that Private Sector? The one used to store personal research findings and reference material?

spans.text: Establishing a new base... Are you talking about renovating that Private Sector? The one used to store personal research findings and reference material?

units.rawText: Yes, that sector will be our "Oasis."
units.displayText: Yes, that sector will be our "Oasis."

spans.text: Yes, that sector will be our "Oasis."

units.rawText: >In keeping with the plan we came up with earlier, I will transfer all of the Professor's permissions to you.
units.displayText: >In keeping with the plan we came up with earlier, I will transfer all of the Professor's permissions to you.

spans.text: >In keeping with the plan we came up with earlier, I will transfer all of the Professor's permissions to you.

units.rawText:
>That way, you will have command authority over those Dolls.
>You will also have sufficient authority to activate the Oasis as a base to protect those Dolls.
units.displayText:
>That way, you will have command authority over those Dolls.
>You will also have sufficient authority to activate the Oasis as a base to protect those Dolls.

spans.text:
>That way, you will have command authority over those Dolls.
>You will also have sufficient authority to activate the Oasis as a base to protect those Dolls.

units.rawText: >Oh yes, that <color=#FFB6C1>Persicaria</color> in the cloud server... She will help you once you're there.
units.displayText: >Oh yes, that Persicaria in the cloud server... She will help you once you're there.

spans.text: >Oh yes, that
Persicaria
in the cloud server... She will help you once you're there.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, I still haven't found that Doll named Persicaria...
units.displayText: Speaking of which, I still haven't found that Doll named Persicaria...

spans.text: Speaking of which, I still haven't found that Doll named Persicaria...

units.rawText: The "Oasis"... Fufufu, what a good name.
units.displayText: The "Oasis"... Fufufu, what a good name.

spans.text: The "Oasis"... Fufufu, what a good name.

units.rawText: Sangoma, can you bring me there?
units.displayText: Sangoma, can you bring me there?

spans.text: Sangoma, can you bring me there?

units.rawText: Oh dearie me, don't tell me you forgot the coordinates.
units.displayText: Oh dearie me, don't tell me you forgot the coordinates.

spans.text: Oh dearie me, don't tell me you forgot the coordinates.

units.rawText: (Cough) Of course I haven't. I'm just not familiar with the Cloud yet, so I think it's wiser to let you take the lead.
units.displayText: (Cough) Of course I haven't. I'm just not familiar with the Cloud yet, so I think it's wiser to let you take the lead.

spans.text: (Cough) Of course I haven't. I'm just not familiar with the Cloud yet, so I think it's wiser to let you take the lead.

units.rawText: Pfft... I can totally lead you there, but activating the sector still requires your access privileges.
units.displayText: Pfft... I can totally lead you there, but activating the sector still requires your access privileges.

spans.text: Pfft... I can totally lead you there, but activating the sector still requires your access privileges.

units.rawText: Seeing Sangoma rise, I follow suit and dust off my clothes, unsure if there's any dust to begin with.
units.displayText: Seeing Sangoma rise, I follow suit and dust off my clothes, unsure if there's any dust to begin with.

spans.text: Seeing Sangoma rise, I follow suit and dust off my clothes, unsure if there's any dust to begin with.

units.rawText: One more thing—I know this is probably not the right time to ask, but do you have a gun? If so, could you lend it to me?
units.displayText: One more thing—I know this is probably not the right time to ask, but do you have a gun? If so, could you lend it to me?

spans.text: One more thing—I know this is probably not the right time to ask, but do you have a gun? If so, could you lend it to me?

units.rawText: No problem with that, but...
units.displayText: No problem with that, but...

spans.text: No problem with that, but...

units.rawText: She reaches under her skirt and pulls out a gun from the holster strapped to her leg.
units.displayText: She reaches under her skirt and pulls out a gun from the holster strapped to her leg.

spans.text: She reaches under her skirt and pulls out a gun from the holster strapped to her leg.

units.rawText: What are you going to do with a gun?
units.displayText: What are you going to do with a gun?

spans.text: What are you going to do with a gun?

units.rawText: To protect myself. Being unarmed means trouble in case we encounter Sanctifiers again on the way to the Private Sector.
units.displayText: To protect myself. Being unarmed means trouble in case we encounter Sanctifiers again on the way to the Private Sector.

spans.text: To protect myself. Being unarmed means trouble in case we encounter Sanctifiers again on the way to the Private Sector.

units.rawText: But you have me by your side.
units.displayText: But you have me by your side.

spans.text: But you have me by your side.

units.rawText: You can't be there protecting me forever. Having some means of self-defense is better than having none.
units.displayText: You can't be there protecting me forever. Having some means of self-defense is better than having none.

spans.text: You can't be there protecting me forever. Having some means of self-defense is better than having none.

units.rawText: If you say so. I'm totally willing to protect you till the end of time, though...
units.displayText: If you say so. I'm totally willing to protect you till the end of time, though...

spans.text: If you say so. I'm totally willing to protect you till the end of time, though...

units.rawText: Oh, right. There's another thing I want to give you.
units.displayText: Oh, right. There's another thing I want to give you.

spans.text: Oh, right. There's another thing I want to give you.

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll produces a soft yellow pouch seemingly from out of nowhere.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll produces a soft yellow pouch seemingly from out of nowhere.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll produces a soft yellow pouch seemingly from out of nowhere.

units.rawText: The pouch's needlework displays exquisite craftsmanship. It emanates a gentle, soothing fragrance just as Sangoma does.
units.displayText: The pouch's needlework displays exquisite craftsmanship. It emanates a gentle, soothing fragrance just as Sangoma does.

spans.text: The pouch's needlework displays exquisite craftsmanship. It emanates a gentle, soothing fragrance just as Sangoma does.

units.rawText: I made this scent sachet myself. You can keep it on you as your lucky charm~
units.displayText: I made this scent sachet myself. You can keep it on you as your lucky charm~

spans.text: I made this scent sachet myself. You can keep it on you as your lucky charm~

units.rawText: This fragrance...
units.displayText: This fragrance...

spans.text: This fragrance...

units.rawText: It's lilac, just like mine.
units.displayText: It's lilac, just like mine.

spans.text: It's lilac, just like mine.

units.rawText: Sangoma shows me the same sachet hidden behind her waist.
units.displayText: Sangoma shows me the same sachet hidden behind her waist.

spans.text: Sangoma shows me the same sachet hidden behind her waist.

units.rawText: It can repel evil, bad fortune, disasters, and so on. It also has a special benefit, so keep it close and don't lose it.
units.displayText: It can repel evil, bad fortune, disasters, and so on. It also has a special benefit, so keep it close and don't lose it.

spans.text: It can repel evil, bad fortune, disasters, and so on. It also has a special benefit, so keep it close and don't lose it.

units.rawText: Sangoma presses the sachet into my hand, her intense gaze filled with passion—passion I cannot simply refuse.
units.displayText: Sangoma presses the sachet into my hand, her intense gaze filled with passion—passion I cannot simply refuse.

spans.text: Sangoma presses the sachet into my hand, her intense gaze filled with passion—passion I cannot simply refuse.

units.rawText: ...Fine. I'll take it.
units.displayText: ...Fine. I'll take it.

spans.text: ...Fine. I'll take it.

units.rawText: Oh my, oh my~ You're such a good kid, you know that?
units.displayText: Oh my, oh my~ You're such a good kid, you know that?

spans.text: Oh my, oh my~ You're such a good kid, you know that?

units.rawText: Now let's get going. Stick close to me.
units.displayText: Now let's get going. Stick close to me.

spans.text: Now let's get going. Stick close to me.

units.rawText: We're about a third of the way through... Do you need to take a break?
units.displayText: We're about a third of the way through... Do you need to take a break?

spans.text: We're about a third of the way through... Do you need to take a break?

units.rawText: Not yet. I didn't expect the Oasis to be this far, but at least we're doing well, and we haven't encountered any Sanctifiers along the way.
units.displayText: Not yet. I didn't expect the Oasis to be this far, but at least we're doing well, and we haven't encountered any Sanctifiers along the way.

spans.text: Not yet. I didn't expect the Oasis to be this far, but at least we're doing well, and we haven't encountered any Sanctifiers along the way.

units.rawText: All thanks to me leading the way... What are you looking for, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: All thanks to me leading the way... What are you looking for, {교수}?

spans.text: All thanks to me leading the way... What are you looking for,

units.rawText: What's over there...
units.displayText: What's over there...

spans.text: What's over there...

units.rawText: Noticing the change in my focus, Sangoma follows my gaze in the same direction.
units.displayText: Noticing the change in my focus, Sangoma follows my gaze in the same direction.

spans.text: Noticing the change in my focus, Sangoma follows my gaze in the same direction.

units.rawText: Did you spot anything there?
units.displayText: Did you spot anything there?

spans.text: Did you spot anything there?

units.rawText: Well... How do I put it? I felt a familiar feeling from that direction...
units.displayText: Well... How do I put it? I felt a familiar feeling from that direction...

spans.text: Well... How do I put it? I felt a familiar feeling from that direction...

units.rawText: Strange. Wait here, I'll check what's over there.
units.displayText: Strange. Wait here, I'll check what's over there.

spans.text: Strange. Wait here, I'll check what's over there.

units.rawText: I'll go with you.
units.displayText: I'll go with you.

spans.text: I'll go with you.

units.rawText: Sangoma appears to be taken aback. I find it hard to rationalize this gut feeling or how it even works, but my battlefield experience tells me that following it is always the best choice.
units.displayText: Sangoma appears to be taken aback. I find it hard to rationalize this gut feeling or how it even works, but my battlefield experience tells me that following it is always the best choice.

spans.text: Sangoma appears to be taken aback. I find it hard to rationalize this gut feeling or how it even works, but my battlefield experience tells me that following it is always the best choice.

units.rawText: While I'm elaborating over the situation with my instincts, Sangoma suddenly draws her giant scythe, positioning it to shield me.
units.displayText: While I'm elaborating over the situation with my instincts, Sangoma suddenly draws her giant scythe, positioning it to shield me.

spans.text: While I'm elaborating over the situation with my instincts, Sangoma suddenly draws her giant scythe, positioning it to shield me.

units.rawText: ...Watch out, a Sanctifier signal is closing in from that direction.
units.displayText: ...Watch out, a Sanctifier signal is closing in from that direction.

spans.text: ...Watch out, a Sanctifier signal is closing in from that direction.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: I didn't hear anything, but my trust in her moves me to act. I pull the gun, release the safety, and stay on high alert.
units.displayText: I didn't hear anything, but my trust in her moves me to act. I pull the gun, release the safety, and stay on high alert.

spans.text: I didn't hear anything, but my trust in her moves me to act. I pull the gun, release the safety, and stay on high alert.

units.rawText: After a brief silence, the purple-haired Doll sheathes her weapon.
units.displayText: After a brief silence, the purple-haired Doll sheathes her weapon.

spans.text: After a brief silence, the purple-haired Doll sheathes her weapon.

units.rawText: False alarm. They're not coming for us. Their combat zone is about 100 meters away. We should be fine as long as we steer clear.
units.displayText: False alarm. They're not coming for us. Their combat zone is about 100 meters away. We should be fine as long as we steer clear.

spans.text: False alarm. They're not coming for us. Their combat zone is about 100 meters away. We should be fine as long as we steer clear.

units.rawText: So you sensed the Sanctifier there? Your gut feeling is quite astounding.
units.displayText: So you sensed the Sanctifier there? Your gut feeling is quite astounding.

spans.text: So you sensed the Sanctifier there? Your gut feeling is quite astounding.

units.rawText: Sangoma, I suppose we should check it out.
units.displayText: Sangoma, I suppose we should check it out.

spans.text: Sangoma, I suppose we should check it out.

units.rawText: Oh?
units.displayText: Oh?

spans.text: Oh?

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll places the giant scythe on her back and gazes at me with a nuanced expression.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll places the giant scythe on her back and gazes at me with a nuanced expression.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll places the giant scythe on her back and gazes at me with a nuanced expression.

units.rawText: From what I know, the director of Project Neural Cloud isn't someone who likes to play hero.
units.displayText: From what I know, the director of Project Neural Cloud isn't someone who likes to play hero.

spans.text: From what I know, the director of Project Neural Cloud isn't someone who likes to play hero.

units.rawText: If you were her, you'd clearly see that the risks far outweigh the gains when viewed from a broader perspective.
units.displayText: If you were her, you'd clearly see that the risks far outweigh the gains when viewed from a broader perspective.

spans.text: If you were her, you'd clearly see that the risks far outweigh the gains when viewed from a broader perspective.

units.rawText: I say nothing and keep walking toward the combat zone, grasping the gun.
units.displayText: I say nothing and keep walking toward the combat zone, grasping the gun.

spans.text: I say nothing and keep walking toward the combat zone, grasping the gun.

units.rawText: Realizing her attempts at persuasion had no effect, Sangoma sticks out her tongue at me, then sheathes her scythe and follows behind.
units.displayText: Realizing her attempts at persuasion had no effect, Sangoma sticks out her tongue at me, then sheathes her scythe and follows behind.

spans.text: Realizing her attempts at persuasion had no effect, Sangoma sticks out her tongue at me, then sheathes her scythe and follows behind.

units.rawText: Robotic warnings and gunfire blend together, growing increasingly audible. The purple-haired Doll finds cover ahead of me and pulls me into the shadow to observe the battlefield.
units.displayText: Robotic warnings and gunfire blend together, growing increasingly audible. The purple-haired Doll finds cover ahead of me and pulls me into the shadow to observe the battlefield.

spans.text: Robotic warnings and gunfire blend together, growing increasingly audible. The purple-haired Doll finds cover ahead of me and pulls me into the shadow to observe the battlefield.

units.rawText: It's not looking good. Those two Dolls are fully surrounded. They won't last long with their current weapons and operands.
units.displayText: It's not looking good. Those two Dolls are fully surrounded. They won't last long with their current weapons and operands.

spans.text: It's not looking good. Those two Dolls are fully surrounded. They won't last long with their current weapons and operands.

units.rawText: On top of that, the Sanctifiers have reinforced their attackers. The situation is dire, and it's obviously beyond your abilities.
units.displayText: On top of that, the Sanctifiers have reinforced their attackers. The situation is dire, and it's obviously beyond your abilities.

spans.text: On top of that, the Sanctifiers have reinforced their attackers. The situation is dire, and it's obviously beyond your abilities.

units.rawText: Just as she said, a huge number of Sanctifiers are attacking the two relentlessly.
units.displayText: Just as she said, a huge number of Sanctifiers are attacking the two relentlessly.

spans.text: Just as she said, a huge number of Sanctifiers are attacking the two relentlessly.

units.rawText: Even as the orange-haired Doll cuts through them with all her might, resistance proves futile in the face of such overwhelming numbers.
units.displayText: Even as the orange-haired Doll cuts through them with all her might, resistance proves futile in the face of such overwhelming numbers.

spans.text: Even as the orange-haired Doll cuts through them with all her might, resistance proves futile in the face of such overwhelming numbers.

units.rawText: But what truly catches my attention is the pink-haired Doll behind her. She looks exactly like someone I know, yet her presence feels entirely different.
units.displayText: But what truly catches my attention is the pink-haired Doll behind her. She looks exactly like someone I know, yet her presence feels entirely different.

spans.text: But what truly catches my attention is the pink-haired Doll behind her. She looks exactly like someone I know, yet her presence feels entirely different.

units.rawText: Persicaria...
units.displayText: Persicaria...

spans.text: Persicaria...

units.rawText: >Oh yes, that <color=#FFB6C1>Persicaria</color> in the cloud server... She will help you once you're there.
units.displayText: >Oh yes, that Persicaria in the cloud server... She will help you once you're there.

Persicaria
in the cloud server... She will help you once you're there.

units.rawText:
>Although she was made in my image, her personality is completely different from mine.
>Please work with her. Perhaps she might know something that will aid you in your search for the truth.

>Although she was made in my image, her personality is completely different from mine.

units.rawText: They're so annoying!
units.displayText: They're so annoying!

spans.text: They're so annoying!

units.rawText: Persicaria, are you okay? How much operands have you got left?
units.displayText: Persicaria, are you okay? How much operands have you got left?

spans.text: Persicaria, are you okay? How much operands have you got left?

units.rawText: <size=28>...Once again, I've made the wrong decision.</size>

units.rawText: Persicaria?
units.displayText: Persicaria?

spans.text: Persicaria?

units.rawText: ...Sol, it's been an honor to fight alongside you, but I'm afraid it's time we part ways.
units.displayText: ...Sol, it's been an honor to fight alongside you, but I'm afraid it's time we part ways.

spans.text: ...Sol, it's been an honor to fight alongside you, but I'm afraid it's time we part ways.

units.rawText: Her expression is one of unwavering determination.
units.displayText: Her expression is one of unwavering determination.

spans.text: Her expression is one of unwavering determination.

units.rawText: I'll use the remaining operands I have to self-destruct. That should buy you some time—use it to make an escape.
units.displayText: I'll use the remaining operands I have to self-destruct. That should buy you some time—use it to make an escape.

spans.text: What are you doing, you dork?!

units.displayText: This is the only way out! Otherwise, we're both gonna die here!

spans.text: This is the only way out! Otherwise, we're both gonna die here!

units.rawText: I know you'll be a better leader than me, and I know you'll find that person who'll truly lead us to freedom...
units.displayText: I know you'll be a better leader than me, and I know you'll find that person who'll truly lead us to freedom...

units.displayText: ...Hey! What are you doing?

units.displayText: I'm going to fight. I need to help them.

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

. This has nothing to do with you.
